propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107+ emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model receives openai: prefix because v2 will change that prefix from Chat Completions to Responses
rebar's _pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target compose and return the ambiguous openai: qualifier, causing the warning at runtime

ProviderSession gates for cfg.base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint override only match the legacy openai provider name, so explicit openai-chat: targets would lose custom-endpoint routing
All inferred and legacy-explicit OpenAI model targets must normalize to openai-chat: to preserve Chat Completions semantics and maintain backward compatibility with custom endpoints
Both configured openai/openai-chat provider aliases and inline openai:/openai-chat: spellings must be treated as one provider family for conflict detection and fallback resolution
